latest_version_confirmed: 1.0.1 (build 1.100.619, released 2026-07-15) is the newest version as of 2026-07-27; it is a bug-fix hotfix (save-data loss, Burning status, PS/Xbox fixes) with NO pal roster or breeding changes since 1.0. No 1.0.2+ exists.
formula: Every pal species has a hidden integer CombiRank. When two pals of opposite gender breed, the game computes target = floor((rank_parentA + rank_parentB + 1) / 2) and the child species is the pal in the generic breeding pool whose CombiRank is closest to that target. If two species are exactly equidistant from the target, the tie is broken toward the HIGHER CombiRank (1.0 behavior; verified in-game: Turtacle 2410 + Aegidron 30 -> target 1220, tie between Quivern 1210 and Nitemary 1230, real result Nitemary). NB: some pre-1.0 guides claim ties go to the lower paldex index -- that is outdated. Parent order does not matter. Special combos override the formula entirely: a listed parent pair always produces its fixed child, and pals that only appear as special-combo children (elemental/regional variants, legendaries, and other excluded species) can never result from the rank formula.
tie_break: On an exact CombiRank tie, the child is the pal with the HIGHER CombiRank (verified in-game 1.0: Turtacle 2410 + Aegidron 30 -> target 1220 -> Nitemary 1230 over Quivern 1210).
same_species: breeding two pals of the same species always yields that species
gender_requirement: one male + one female; genders do not affect child species

excluded_from_generic_pool.why: The averaging formula can NEVER output these; obtain them via their special combo or same-species pairing.

new_in_1_0.mutation: Small chance a bred pal hatches stronger than expected with a unique mutation-only passive. Species is chosen on a SEPARATE branch (may differ from the normal child). Mushroom/Deluxe Vegetable Cake raise the chance.
new_in_1_0.awakening: Not breeding: spend Radiant Gems (World Tree) to boost a pal's stats and unlock powerful passives.

cakes.Special Cake: better chance to inherit multiple passives

new_in_1_0.condensation: 1.0 lowered max-condensation cost to 48 food-copies (keeper +47) for 4-star; each star adds +1 to all work suitabilities (4-star = +1 to every job).

gaps: Tie-break rule has conflicting documentation: palworld.wiki.gg says the lower internal index wins on exact CombiRank ties, while one 1.0-era aggregator claims ties resolve to the higher CombiRank; not independently verified in-game for 1.0.
Eleven crossover pals share CombiRank 3100, so formula results among them depend entirely on the tie-break rule / their exclusion from the generic pool.
paldb.cc does not print an explicit game-version stamp on the Breeding_Farm page; 1.0 provenance is inferred from its exact match with the 299-pal 1.0 paldex and 1.0-only species.
